newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga sees 1997 net 145 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga sees 1997 net 145 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian toll-road operator Citra Marga Nusphala Persada expects a net profit of 145 billion rupiah in 1997, Citra corporate finance manager Ilham Wardhana Sriegar said on Wednesday.
He told an analysts' meeting that net profit this year was expected to be 123 billion rupiah.

"Based on the 1996 third quarter performance, we believe we can achieve a net profit of 123 billion rupiah this year," he said. "Based on this performance, we project 1997 net profit at 145 billion rupiah."
Citra posted a net profit of 94 billion rupiah in 1995.
